title: Înflorire
description:
'Blooming'
The work evokes the delicate moment of early summer, when the garden becomes an intimate space filled with life and sensitivity.
I imagined a vegetal wall adorned with purple wisteria, yet the focus is not on abundance, but on essence: the foliage dominates the composition—rich and vibrant—in nuanced shades of green and purple, like an organic tapestry.

At the top, a few wisteria flowers—painted in tones of mauve and violet—appear as rare and precious accents.
Their limited presence is intentional: the flowers become jewels, fragile treasures hidden within nature, symbols of ephemerality and refinement.

The work captures the subtle relationship between the fullness of the foliage and the delicacy of the flowers, speaking about beauty that does not shout, but reveals itself to those who look with attention.
